source: Advanced short story written in spoken Palestinian by Claude. NOT native-validated.

sentences.ar: رجال كان عنده عصفور حلو بقفص ذهبي.
sentences.en: A man had a beautiful bird in a golden cage.

sentences.ar: كان يطعمه أحسن أكل ويهتم فيه كتير.
sentences.en: He would feed it the best food and care for it a lot.

sentences.ar: بس العصفور ما كان يغني أبدا.
sentences.en: But the bird never used to sing.
The man was puzzled, why was his bird sad?

sentences.ar: جاب له قفص أكبر وأحلى، بس ما فرقت.
sentences.en: He got it a bigger and nicer cage, but it made no difference.

sentences.ar: مرة، إجاه ضيف حكيم وشاف العصفور.
sentences.en: Once, a wise guest came to him and saw the bird.

sentences.ar: قال: هالعصفور ما بيغني لأنه مش حر.
sentences.en: He said: this bird doesn't sing because it isn't free.

sentences.ar: الرجال قال: بس أنا بحبه وبهتم فيه.
sentences.en: The man said: but I love it and I care for it.

sentences.ar: الحكيم رد: المحبة الحقيقية إنك تطلق اللي بتحبه.
sentences.en: The wise man replied: true love is to release the one you love.
The man thought for a long time about these words.

sentences.ar: الصبح التاني، حمل القفص وطلع عالحديقة.
sentences.en: The next morning, he carried the cage and went out to the garden.

sentences.ar: فتح باب القفص وقال: روح، إنت حر.
sentences.en: He opened the cage door and said: go, you are free.
The bird flew to the nearby tree.

sentences.ar: وقف هناك، وبلش يغني أحلى غنا.
sentences.en: It stood there, and started to sing the most beautiful song.

sentences.ar: الرجال حس بفرح ما حسه من قبل.
sentences.en: The man felt a joy he had never felt before.

sentences.ar: فهم يومها إنه الحرية أغلى من الذهب.
sentences.en: That day he understood that freedom is more precious than gold.
